result:
The full web e2e run that started after my first handback was killed by the session time limit, but before that it showed my spec was breaking other specs. I've fixed my spec. It also exposed a High-severity backend defect that you need to route.

**Backend defect (for slice A's owner, BE-A…BE-C).** Publishing any methodology version, even one that only changes help text, gives every transformation created afterwards empty DG2 catalogues.
- **Where:** `loadMethodologyCatalogue` in `apps/api/src/modules/methodology/repository.ts`.
- **Cause:** it reads diagnostic dimensions and workstreams, TOM dimensions, charter scope checks, good-outcome criteria and gate definitions only for the pinned version. Those rows exist only for the seeded v1, and new transformations pin the newest published version.
- **Effect:** in the e2e, `diagnosticWorkstreams` came back empty and the Diagnose screen showed 0 of 6 workstreams. Real use of the Studio on the methodology breaks REQ-S06-007 and S06-008.
- **Status:** not fixed by me; the file isn't FE-B's. Reproduction and the expected behaviour are in §5 item 5 of the handback.

**Defects in my own work, all fixed:**
- My spec gave `dev.nobody` the methodology-admin role and never removed it, so the Arabic run of `journeys.spec.ts` ("a user without roles sees no Administration") failed. The spec now revokes the grant at the end of each test.
- Because of the backend defect, the e2e journey now runs draft → review → publish on a **T06 scoring-defaults** version. It changes one rubric descriptor and keeps the weights at 25/25/20/15/15. The same path on a methodology version did pass in my earlier run, but I can't keep it in the spec until the backend defect is fixed.
- The scoring-defaults editor remounted after a save, which lost the "Draft saved" notice. It would also have wiped unsaved edits on a background refresh. Both are fixed.

**Checks:**

| Check | Exit | Result |
|---|---|---|
| typecheck, build, lint, openapi lint | 0 | |
| prettier (whole repo) | 0 | rerun after the fixes |
| `pnpm test`, locale unset and C.UTF-8 | 1 each | web 1429/1429; third run 259 passed, 2 skipped; node 1942/1943 |
| that one node test run alone | 0 | |
| integration | 0 | 2342/2342 |
| historical DG4 validator | 0 | |
| `journeys`, `p2-journeys`, `p5-studio` specs, EN and AR, after the fixes | 0 | 46/46 |
| full web e2e suite | — | not completed; partial log only |

The single node failure is `architecture.test.ts` hitting its 30 s timeout under machine load; I changed no API files.

Please re-run `pnpm test` in both locales and the full web e2e suite on the integrated tree. The integrated tree needs the backend fix before any test publishes a methodology version. The handback (updated 13:25 UTC) and evidence are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG5/`. Changes are uncommitted.
